The '''Russet Slopes''' was a wooded area in the [[Old Paths]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. The hills were home to many [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]], and the [[Voss commandos]] maintained [[Ken-La Outpost]] on the northern slopes.
